excluded_hours.2026-10-22T06:30:00+08:00: input_unavailable: No weather observation in the hour of, or within 1:30:00 before, 2026-10-22 06:30

sample: First saved capture of each development hour; alternatives are all 30511 directed segments

peak_onsets.method: Per day category, the two most prominent local maxima of the circular mean hourly live city load (length-weighted mean live congestion, averaged over the five cities), in clock order; each onset is the steepest hourly rise between the preceding low point and the peak; departure one collection interval (15 min) before the onset hour. No clock hours are assumed.

road_class_severity.definition: p_k = 1 - median free-flow speed of class k / largest class median, over development roads; a stated preference for faster road classes, not a published penalty.

flood_class_severity.note: NOAH five-year hazard classes 1-3 are mapped susceptibility, not current inundation or road closure. Overlapping polygons resolve to the highest class.

live_assumptions.status: Assumed values for the live features; not calibrated. Each value is reported with the results and can be varied in sensitivity runs.
live_assumptions.min_free_flow_note: HERE flow lines with a free-flow speed below 2 m/s (7.2 km/h) are not usable (for example ferry routes reported at 0.28 m/s) and are left out before matching.

flood_report.note: A HERE incident whose type is flooding or whose description mentions flooding marks the matched segments as flooded now. Their flood exposure becomes the whole segment length at the highest severity; other segments keep the NOAH hazard exposure.

capacity_factors.note: Live effective capacity = base capacity (directional lanes x 1,900 veh/h/lane x g/C) x incident factor x flood factor x weather factor. A lane-blocking incident removes one lane: (lanes - 1) / lanes, but not below single_lane_floor. Flooding and rain reduce capacity by the assumed factors (supported in direction by Mamuyac et al., 2025, for flooding).

live_assumptions.time_of_day_note: Live time-of-day load = length-weighted mean live congestion of the matched roads in the same city at the snapshot time: how busy the city is right now. It differs from a road's own congestion, so the two features are not duplicates.
live_assumptions.uncovered_roads_note: A road without a live HERE line takes the median live congestion of matched roads of the same city and road type; then of the same road type; then of all matched roads. These values are flagged group_estimate.
